envelope.description: The controller review path prepares and normalizes coverage the same way

body.title: The controller review path prepares and normalizes coverage the same way
body.summary: In src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/handler.ts, build the coverage prompt from prepareCoverageGrounding with the review's groundingMode (:444), give the controller's coverage judgement schema findingKind/symbolId, and apply normalizeCoverageFindings with the subject before injecting the coverage result into the runner (:528).
acceptanceChecks: On the controller path a graph-gap HIGH is lowered and the folded verdict is not 'block', as on the daemon path.
The controller's coverage prompt is the same prepared list the daemon path uses.

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/__tests__/coverage-normalized-paths.test.ts: 'on both the controller and daemon paths a lowered graph-gap finding is LOW and the folded verdict is not block'
src/daemon/steps/code-review-step/__tests__/coverage-normalized-paths.test.ts: 'the daemon diff path reaches the coverage judge as degraded, also with an empty grounding'
